venues.name: Eastview Cricket Field
venues.notes: Under the control of Eastview Christian Church. It is private property: use it only as directed and according to the church’s rules.

venues.name: Normal cricket ground
venues.notes: Under the control of the City of Normal and CICA. Use it according to CICA’s rules and those of the Normal Park District.

venues.name: Baywood cricket ground
venues.notes: Under the control of CICA, with Bloomington Parks rules. Captains remind players about the speed limit in the Baywood neighborhood.

venues.name: Bloomington Table Tennis (BTT)
venues.parking: Teams and spectators use the designated parking areas.
venues.notes: Indoor turf for the 2025 indoor tournaments. Every player signs the BTT waiver before playing. No smoking on the premises, and the tennis courts are off limits.
